newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 18.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* Composite Index of 100 blue chips seen continuing to drift lower after ending off 0.47 of a point to 1,076.93 on Tuesday. Second Board of small-capitalisation shares slipped 3.98 points to 570.19.
* The market is seen "drifting sideways", said Jonathan Duckett, institutional dealer at Mohaiyani Securities. "I think 1,050 is the next support level."
* Ekran to hold news conference at noon.

Ekran, main developer of Bakun dam, just completed a poorly-received rights offering that was undersubscribed by 62.77 percent. It is due to list shares of the Bakun hydroelectric dam operating company in August.

* Among companies releasing results after hours on Tuesday were Malaywata Steel, with year net profit up 52 percent to 43.38 million ringgit. Malaysian Plantations posted year net profit of 82.01 million ringgit versus 17.10 million.
Matsushita Electric Co (Malaysia) year net up to 59.81 million ringgit versus 57.75 million.
* Suspended Berjaya Land issues statement saying it is proposing to buy office space and hotel facilities for 190.97 million ringgit.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5151/61 a dollar at 1000 GMT on Tuesday against 2.5155/65 at close in Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
